body.intro: Hi there! 👋🏼 I'm Paula, a Frontend Developer based in Argentina.
body.expertise: I specialize in building digital solutions and modern, responsive, and accessible interfaces, with a strong focus on design, user experience, and thoughtful motion that makes digital products feel polished, intuitive, and engaging.
body.collaboration: I believe collaboration, clear communication, and attention to detail are essential to creating successful digital experiences. I enjoy working closely with designers, developers, and product teams.
body.availability: I'm currently open to remote and hybrid job opportunities where I can contribute, add value, and continue growing professionally.

tasks.task1: Developed and maintained WordPress websites (Elementor, JetEngine, Code Snippets) and online stores using WooCommerce and Tienda Nube for multiple agency clients.
tasks.task2: Built components and interfaces with React.js and Tailwind CSS, integrating custom logic with AJAX and PHP.
tasks.task3: Designed and implemented automations with Google AppScript, including a Telegram bot connected to Google Sheets, Drive, and Mail to streamline internal processes.
tasks.task4: Worked closely with the design team to bring Figma mockups into production with a high level of visual fidelity.

tasks.task1: Managed the full lifecycle of freelance projects, from requirements gathering and proposals to development and delivery, working directly with each client.
tasks.task2: Developed online stores with Tienda Nube and custom landing pages, with a focus on performance and conversion.
tasks.task3: Adapted project scope and timelines to each client's specific needs while maintaining clear communication throughout the process.

tasks.task1: Developed frontend interfaces using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript within a DXP and Handlebars.js-based CMS.
tasks.task2: Implemented animations and microinteractions with GSAP to enhance the user experience across different sections of the website.
tasks.task3: Worked with Bootstrap to build responsive components while adapting to the standards of a remote team based in Canada.
